translations.text: Augustine brought this letter from the south over the salt sea to the island-dwellers, as the Lord's champion, the pope of Rome, had composed it beforehand.
The wise-minded Gregory studied many true teachings through the wisdom of his mind, his hoard of shrewd thoughts.
Because of this he won the greatest part of mankind for the Guardian of the heavens, he the best of the Romans, the richest in spirit of men, the most renowned for glorious deeds.
After King Alfred had translated every word of me into English, and sent me south and north to his scribes, he ordered more such copies to be brought to him, made from that exemplar,
so that he could send it to his bishops, because some of them needed it, those who knew the Latin language least.
